claim: tl-building-the-pmo fallback source: PMI stats; NPfIT more than £10bn in quiz
src: PMI Pulse 2018: ~$2 trillion wasted a year; 2020: 11.4% average waste — different years conflated; PMI Pulse 2017: strategy-aligned EPMO -> 38% more projects meet original goals (not PMO vs none, on time/budget); UK Public Accounts Committee HC 294 (2013): estimated cost £9.8bn (likely more) — "more than £10 billion" not supported by the primary source
